'''Dance''' can refer to the following:

==Songs==
*[[A Lugard Girl]] - a song that [[Perrin Aybara]] knows as The Dancing Lass.
*''[[Dance with Jak o' the Shadows]]'' - a song popular in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].
*[[Three Girls in a Meadow]] - a song that the ''[[Tuatha'an]]'' know as Pretty Maids Dancing.
*[[What He Said To Me]] - a song that [[Matrim Cauthon]] knows as Will You Dance With Me.

==Chapter titles==
*''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 34|A Different Dance]]'' - the thirty-forth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
*''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 19|The Wavedancer]]'' - the ninteenth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
*''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 5|A Different Dance]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
